plan.timing: Fixed before fitting or scoring any V65 model.
plan.hypothesis: A small event-only correction may improve user click propensity without disturbing conditional item choice learned by the incumbent.
plan.base: Exact saved V50 plain16 head for each held-user fold, chronological or full stage; unchanged.
plan.features: User/history/activity columns explicitly named in event_mass_correction.py, plus frozen V50 event logit. Event columns are checked constant across every slate. No item ID, user ID, labels or raw weekend indicator as features.
plan.formula: V63 conditional candidate probabilities multiplied by sigmoid(logit(V63 event mass)+strength*V65 bounded event-logit delta).
plan.selection: Require combined matched gain >=.000010, both matched dates positive, non-worsening log loss, and both weekday changed-component gains positive. Highest eligible gain; within .000005 prefer smaller strength.
plan.confirmation: Only preselected eligible recipe gets chronological first-Friday component scoring and 400 paired-user bootstrap seed20261030. No retuning.
plan.limits: Adaptive idea after prior propensity experiments. Base head trained on same fitting users; validation users excluded from base and correction across all six days. Daily features causal but calibration pools other-user dates. Weekday/forward diagnostics omit unchanged historical V17/V20. Reused development cohorts and conditional uncertainty do not guarantee public gain.
